source.description: Versioned synthetic V1.3 multi-leg inputs, preserving prior fixed BUY batches and adding OD-014 strict settled-cash SELL/BUY normal and insufficient-settled-cash scenarios; not market data.
source.license: Internal synthetic fixture; no external market data or broker access

semantics.prices: Synthetic fixed limit prices; decimal strings, no external market provenance.

sessions.calendar: Synthetic fixed V1.3 session; does not imply settlement calendar.

qualityCases: two BUY legs and exact per-leg fees
insufficient settled-cash rejection with zero orders and fills
first-leg response-loss recovery with stable child clientOrderIds
AUTO_POLICY fixed two-leg BUY: one aggregate Mandate budget reservation and per-leg Portfolio reservations, with exact cash and positions
US_EQUITY AUTO_POLICY fixed two-leg BUY: one USD 450.10 aggregate Mandate consumption and two per-leg Portfolio reservations
MANUAL mixed SELL/BUY batch posts only against independent Portfolio reservations while SELL proceeds remain pending
AUTO mixed SELL/BUY failure proves pending receivable cannot fund later BUY and releases every reservation and Mandate budget

expectedAssertions.description: CN_A starts with CNY 10000.0000, buys 100 shares each of 600000.SH and 000001.SZ, reserves CNY 2210.0000 and ends at CNY 7790.0000 with 100 shares each.
US_EQUITY starts with USD 10000.0000, buys AAPL and MSFT, reserves USD 450.1000 and ends at USD 9549.9000 with the exact expected positions.
A CNY 0.0001 settled-cash shortfall rejects the whole batch before any FakeBroker order or Fill.
After a first-leg response loss and Trade restart, query the original child clientOrderId and complete only the missing leg; end with two orders, two fills and reconciliation MATCH.

One active AUTO_POLICY Mandate authorizes the fixed CN_A two-leg BUY batch; one CNY 2210.0000 aggregate Mandate reservation and two per-leg Portfolio reservations precede two stable child orders, yielding CNY 7790.0000 and 100 shares each after fills.

One active AUTO_POLICY Mandate authorizes the fixed US_EQUITY two-leg BUY batch; one USD 450.10 aggregate Mandate reservation and per-leg Portfolio reservations precede two stable child orders, yielding USD 9549.9000 and 10 AAPL/5 MSFT shares after fills.
A fixed MANUAL SELL/BUY batch leaves CN_A SELL proceeds as a PENDING receivable while the BUY leg uses settled cash; FakeBroker and Portfolio reconcile.

After settled cash is reduced to CNY 1960.0000, a pending CNY 995.0000 SELL receivable does not fund a later BUY; HTTP 409, zero batch orders/fills, both earlier Portfolio reservations RELEASED, AUTO Mandate budget released.
